description: Calculate the employee turnover (attrition) rate for a month, quarter or year from starting headcount, ending headcount and the number of people who left. Use it when you have headcounts and separations and need the rate; it also annualizes a monthly or quarterly rate. Use employee_retention_rate instead when you can split leavers into people who were there at the start and people hired during the period, and employee_turnover_cost to price the turnover in dollars. Returns the turnover rate for the period, the annualized rate, average headcount and a simple retention rate.

ending_headcount.description: Employees on the payroll at the end of the period.

period.description: The length of the measurement period: month, quarter or year. Default year.

separations.description: People who left during the period, voluntarily or not.

starting_headcount.description: Employees on the payroll at the start of the period.

name: employee_turnover_rate

calculator_url.description: The TeamPredict calculator page that shows the same calculation, where a person can change the inputs.

inputs.description: The inputs as used, with defaults filled in.

results.description: The computed numbers. Unavailable numbers are null.

summary.description: One or two plain sentences with the headline numbers.

title: Employee turnover rate
